description: TEST-ONLY fixture-execution ledger schema. Tracks structural validation of proof-kernel fixtures plus explicit PENDING status for semantic checks awaiting the checker. This ledger records test-fixture runs, never runtime proof derivations.

actual_outcome.description: Observed outcome. PENDING-* values are explicit, never counted as passing.

checker_version.description: Checker or harness version that produced actual_outcome; 'none' when no checker exists yet.

fixture_digest.description: SHA-256 of the exact fixture file bytes at record time.

status.description: layer1-reject-confirmed is a Layer-1 observation only (schema harness), never semantic verification; semantic-pass/fail require a real checker version, never 'none'.

rules.digest_drift: If fixture_digest differs from the file bytes, the ledger is stale; regenerate and rerun.
rules.duplicate_ids: Duplicate fixture_ids are a structural failure.
rules.immutability: Records are append-only per execution_id; a new run writes new records, never edits old ones.
rules.inventory: Every declared fixture file must be present and no undeclared JSON may sit in the fixture directory; --check enforces this without modifying anything.
rules.layer1: layer1-reject-confirmed records Layer-1 schema rejection only; semantic validity stays pending.
rules.pending: pending-semantic records must name the blocking checker contract; they never count as passing.
rules.skips: A skipped fixture without a recorded reason fails the self-check.
rules.staleness: --check compares committed per-file digests and the fixture-id set against the directory; drift fails the check.
